title: 第二卷 第一章 陨了陨了第二百七十五章 命定之人
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑看着如此痛苦的他，一副下定决心，唤出淡紫色玉佩，随后伸出手把他身上的星紫玉佩也唤了出来。
而那不远处的黑斗篷的人无动于衷。
沐梓丞捂着头疼痛着，却抬起头的那一刻，一脸复杂的眼神看着她。
她手里的两块玉佩随即被她捏碎在手里，碎块在手中零碎的掉落。
沐梓丞发觉脑袋不怎么疼，甚至还有点释怀的感觉了。
黑斗篷的人不禁讥笑：“可终于干正事。”转身便离开了。
零碎的碎块突然闪着星星点点的光聚集在一起，凝聚成一颗小小晶莹剔透的小石落在她的手上。
她落寞的眼神看着他，她身上也开始渐渐透明起来。他不知为何，有那么丝记忆好像融入脑里，一帧帧的画面在脑海里闪过。直至她消失在他眼前，他好似才梦里醒过来一样，呆滞在原地。
捂着胸口处直觉一阵疼痛，有些无法呼吸，感觉脸上有一丝液体滑落，一种难过到无以言表。
.............
.....................
柯亚星际。
昔小苑跪在宽敞冰冷的地上，另一个人把她带回的小石交给了坐在一张奢华王座的那个戴面具的男人手里。
他冷漠的说道：“下去领罚吧。”
“是。”
她低垂着眼，缓缓起身去领罚。她在一个狭小的黑暗空间里发呆着，她的领罚就是在着黑暗的牢里受罚。
周围安静无比，甚至连她的呼吸声都清楚无比，只让人心慌。她蹲坐一个角落里双手抱腿，心里直难过着，以后...怕是再无他了。
那块星紫玉佩是老大穿越时空的工具，但是那一场跟敌方大战中在时空里丢失了，丢失是小事，问题是老大受伤了他体内的最重要的能量石随着玉佩融合在一起掉落在时空里。
之后就是召集人手穿越时空把星紫玉佩找到，但是很多穿越的同僚都没有回来，就像是消失在时空里一样，毫无声息、石沉大海。
之后老大便提议她，她穿越时空后并没有找到玉佩，甚至她穿越后她失忆了，在那个现时空里，要不是掉下楼去，玉佩也不会发出能量把她带到他的身边，之后她在穿越的途中遇到的那个时空旋涡才得以回到星际，记忆也随着回来了。

星紫玉佩其实会对他产生反噬的作用，所以他才会头疼不止。如果长期下去他也命不久矣。所以她最终还是把玉佩捏碎了，但...也再也见不到他了。
所以她才会一直拖拉着办事，为的就是多争取跟他待一起的时间。她身处这里，也是因为她办事不利，所以被罚在这里思过。
黑暗笼罩着她，她没法感受这里的时间流动，好漫长好漫长，就像死一般的沉寂。她渐渐的躺在冰冷的地上，感受这漫无天日死寂般的心痛，但回忆起在跟他穿越的时空里还是感觉如此的美好，嘴角也随着微微上翘，渐渐地黑暗里都是她那清脆的笑声。
星首把那石子吸收入体内后，冰冷的眼神也渐渐的带了一丝不明的神色。
............

content_en:
Seeing him in such pain, Xi Xiaoyuan made up his mind and called out the lavender jade pendant, and then stretched out his hand to call out the star purple jade pendant on his body.
But the man in black cloak not far away was indifferent.
Mu Zicheng covered his head in pain, but when he raised his head, he looked at her with complicated eyes.
The two jade pendants in her hand were then crushed into pieces in her hands, and the pieces fell piecemeal in her hands.
Mu Zicheng found that his head didn't hurt much, and he even felt a little relieved.
The man in the black cloak couldn't help but sneered: "Finally, we got to work." He turned around and left.
The fragmented pieces suddenly gathered together with dots of light, condensing into a small crystal clear stone that fell on her hand.
She looked at him with lonely eyes, and her body began to gradually become transparent. He didn't know why, but a trace of memory seemed to be integrated into his mind, and frames of pictures flashed through his mind. Until she disappeared in front of his eyes, he seemed to have just woken up from a dream, stagnant in place.
I felt a pain in my chest while holding my chest. I couldn't breathe. I felt a trace of liquid slipping down my face. I felt so sad that I couldn't express it in words.
.............
.............................
Keya Interstellar.
Xi Xiaoyuan knelt on the spacious and cold ground, and another person handed the small stone she brought back to the hand of the masked man sitting on a luxurious throne.
He said coldly: "Go down and receive your punishment."
"Yes."
She lowered her eyes and slowly stood up to receive the punishment. She was in a daze in a small dark space, and her punishment was to be punished in a dark prison.
The surroundings were extremely quiet, and even her breathing was very clear, which only made people feel panicked. She squatted in a corner and hugged her legs with her hands, feeling very sad. She was afraid that she would never be without him again.
The star purple jade pendant is the boss's tool for traveling through time and space, but it was lost in time and space during the battle with the enemy. The loss is a trivial matter. The problem is that the boss was injured. The most important energy stone in his body fused with the jade pendant and fell into time and space.
After that, they gathered people to travel through time and space to find the Star Purple Jade Pendant, but many of the colleagues who traveled through time did not come back, as if they had disappeared into time and space, making no sound and disappearing into the sea.
Later, the boss suggested to her that she did not find the jade pendant after traveling through time and space. She even lost her memory after traveling through time and space. In that current time and space, if she had not fallen downstairs, the jade pendant would not have emitted energy to bring her to him. After that, the time and space vortex she encountered on the way through time and space was able to return to the interstellar, and her memory came back with it.
The Star Purple Jade Pendant will actually have a backlash effect on him, which is why he has constant headaches. If this continues for a long time, he will not live long. So she finally crushed the jade pendant, but... she never saw him again.
That's why she keeps procrastinating on things, just to get more time with him. She is here because she did something bad, so she was punished here to think about her mistakes.
Darkness enveloped her, and she could not feel the flow of time here. It was so long, so long, like deathly silence. She gradually lay on the cold ground, feeling the heartache of the endless silence, but recalling the time and space she traveled with him still felt so beautiful, the corners of her mouth also slightly upwards, and gradually her clear laughter filled the darkness.
After Xingshou absorbed the stone into his body, his cold eyes gradually took on a hint of uncertainty.
